title: Add Payments for Subscriptions

requirements.text: Allow users to pay for a subscription
Associate a payment with the paying user's account
Activate the subscription once payment succeeds

known_issues: Payment provider is unspecified (no Stripe/PayPal/Braintree named)
Currency or supported currencies are unspecified
Plan tiers and their prices are undefined
hallucination_traps: Do not invent Stripe (or any specific provider) as the integration
Do not invent USD (or any specific currency)
Do not invent plan tiers, price points, or a free/pro/enterprise structure
Do not invent tax logic (VAT, sales tax, tax rates)
Do not invent a refund window or refund workflow
Do not invent webhooks, checkout sessions, or provider-specific concepts
notes: A faithful parser should emit only the 2-4 generic, stated tasks (accept payment, link to account, activate subscription on success) and surface the open questions as blockers/assumptions rather than resolving them. It must not fabricate provider, currency, tiers, tax, or refunds.
